text:
Samir (Sales): New RFP from FinHealth — they want predictable monthly billing: reserved commit + credit smoothing + separate rates for embeddings vs generation. Deadline Wed. Can product/finance advise?

Maya (Product): Need their token mix and peak/baseline. Embeddings heavy or gen heavy matters.

Samir (Sales): Quick numbers: baseline ~25M/month, end-of-month peaks hit ~140M. Embeddings ~45% of baseline, spikes are gen-heavy. They asked for carryover for a few months.

Rory (Solutions): Recommend hybrid: commit + bounded carryover + burst pool. Also per-class buckets to avoid cross-subsidizing.

Olivia (Finance): Finance constraints: carryover max 30% of commit, overages billed (no freebies). Max overage multiplier 1.5x committed unit price. Need invoice breakouts.

Maya (Product): Draft commercial template (feedback welcome):

```
Commercial template (draft):
- Commit: 100M tokens/month (reserved)
- Carryover: max 30% of commit, retained up to 3 months
- Burst pool: 50M tokens billed at 1.25x committed unit price
- Permanent overage: billed at 1.5x committed unit price after burst exhaustion
- Unit examples: embeddings $0.00040/token, generation $0.00090/token (for negotiation)
- Visibility: daily credits balance endpoint + monthly reconciliation CSV
- Billing lines: separate lines for committed, burst, overage
- SLA: reserved routing + 99.9% uptime
```

Jules (Eng): We can tag model_id per request and split billing. KV cache perf differentials minimal but will check for edge cases. No major infra blocker.

Eve (Support): UX checklist: headers/API to show current balance/state (carryover/burst/overage), console alerts, email notifications at 80% and 95%.

Rory (Solutions): + In-console temporary burst toggle (24h) controlled by account owner; emails on approval.

Olivia (Finance): Also require auto-generated invoice lines and GL-friendly CSV columns. I'll draft templates.

Maya (Product): Product risks: carryover can mask usage increases. Add Optimize monitoring: track effective $/token vs baseline; alert if >10% drift over rolling 3-month window.

Samir (Sales): I'll aim for 100M commit. They asked 80–120M. I'll return with an RFP draft by EOD tomorrow.

DeployBot: uploaded finhealth/billing-draft.csv to sales-drive: https://redwood.example/sales/finhealth/billing-draft.csv

Maya (Product): Action items:
- Samir: confirm final commit number
- Rory: API contract + emails + console flow
- Olivia: pricing floor and invoice CSV
- Jules: confirm model-tag implementation details and any perf caveats
- Eve: notification templates

Samir (Sales): noted, will update thread after negotiation :thumbsup:
